description: TikTok Pixel loader and collection requests to analytics.tiktok.com.

params.name: sdkid
params.description: It carries the Pixel ID the loader initializes. TikTok generates this URL in Events Manager rather than documenting the parameter, so this rule is ecosystem evidence, not a published contract.
params.fix_hint: Copy the base code from Events Manager so `sdkid` carries the Pixel ID.
